title: Only What the Lord Says
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
King Ahab wanted to go fight
and asked, “Will I do well?”
The prophets cheered, “You’ll win! You’ll win!”
but truth they did not tell.

[Chorus]
Tell the truth, tell the truth, my dear,
though it is hard to say.
Heavenly Father smiles on those
who tell the truth each day.

[Verse 2]
They told Micaiah, “Say it too;
just say what he wants heard.”
But he was brave: “It won’t go well.”
He spoke the Lord’s true word.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my honest one,
the day’s last words are said.
The Lord who loved Micaiah’s truth
is right here by your bed.

[Chorus]
mood: Marching music. A firm, slow tread under the voice, steady as someone standing their ground, yet gentle enough for a small dark room. The verses keep the pulse plain and honest, with no decoration, and the chorus squares its shoulders a little. By the last verse the tread slows to a rock and drops low, the brave day done.
